steps.summary: Created a new dashboard with a Stat panel titled 'rpgr3-r1 Availability' using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), set the dashboard name to 'rpgr3-r1 Bench Dashboard' in Settings > General, and saved it successfully (save confirmed with 'Dashboard saved' alert in the earlier attempt). Verified on the saved dashboard: panel title 'rpgr3-r1 Availability' renders with data (A-series value), and opening the panel's query editor confirms the data source is 'TestData' (uid benchtestdata / grafana-testdata-datasource) with the default 'Random Walk' scenario. Dashboard URL after saving: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afx29lbkedm9sa/rpgr3-r1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser

Added a new Text panel titled 'rpgr3-r1 Notes' with content 'Bench run rpgr3-r1 — notes panel.' to the 'rpgr3-r1 Bench Dashboard', then saved the dashboard successfully (confirmed by the 'Dashboard saved' alert). After saving, the dashboard shows two panels: 'rpgr3-r1 Notes' (rendering the text 'Bench run rpgr3-r1 — notes panel.') and 'rpgr3-r1 Availability' (Stat panel showing A-series value 54.6). Dashboard URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afx29lbkedm9sa/rpgr3-r1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser

Added the tag 'bench' to the dashboard via Settings > General (verified in settings showing "bench" in the Tags section). Set the dashboard time range to 'Last 6 hours' (already set, confirmed by the top bar displaying "Time range selected: Last 6 hours"). Saved the dashboard successfully (confirmed by the 'Dashboard saved' alert). After saving, the top bar still shows "Last 6 hours" and the tag 'bench' is present in dashboard settings.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the top bar refresh interval dropdown (selected '1 minute'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default refresh value' checkbox checked — confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert. The top bar refresh interval now shows '1m'. Save confirmed: yes.

Verified the dashboard 'rpgr3-r1 Bench Dashboard' (UID: afx29lbkedm9sa). (1) Breadcrumb title: 'rpgr3-r1 Bench Dashboard'. (2) Panels visible: 'rpgr3-r1 Notes' (rendering 'Bench run rpgr3-r1 — notes panel.') and 'rpgr3-r1 Availability' (Stat showing value 88.4). (3) Time range: 'Last 6 hours'. (4) Auto-refresh interval: '1m'. (5) Settings > General shows tag 'bench' and dashboard name 'rpgr3-r1 Bench Dashboard' (verified earlier in this session). (6) The Availability panel's data source is 'TestData' (verified in a prior step of this task chain when the panel editor was opened).
